_note: Phantasie II's terrain key (PLAN P3 QoL, presentation switch TERRAIN KEY, off by default; DIFFERENCES-II D2-014). The rulebook prints a key beside the map (Apple II page: Party, Town/Inn, Dungeon, Path, Desert, Grassland/Forest, Mountains/Hills, River/Lake; p.27 adds Molten Lava, Mist, Dark Voids); the ST shows none. Each entry: the string id of its name (the manual's wording, phantasie2/strings/en.json) and the pack pictures drawn as its swatch, one map cell each (a fill pattern shows its top-left cell, as on the map). Pattern number = cell class (reverse-engineering/atari-st/phantasie2/logic-specs/terrain.md section 5). Readings: town, inn, dungeon and party are the map icons [C]; the ST's fifth icon ('castle': class-4 tiles other than 40 / 41, no rule of their own in overworld.json; OUT12's building, OUT28's cell inside DNG7's ring, OUT30) is scenery the manual's key does not list, so it has no row; lava = class 8 [C]; mist = class 11 and dark voids = class 7 [~] (the manual's descriptions against the ST pictures); path = class 6, hills = 2, mountains = 3 from I's map text [C data]; grassland = 0, forest = 1, desert = 9 are visual readings carried over from I [~] (reverse-engineering/dos/logic-specs/map-tile-graphics.md, overworld-movement.md). Water = class 10 [C]. Path (6) and mist (11) look alike on the ST (sparse grey dots), as the pictures do.
